Apartment 65 Carleton Village, Golf Links Road, Youghal, East Cork

BrochureContent.Content:
Keogh Auctioneers are delighted to offer Apartment 65 Carleton Village, Youghal, Co Cork P36AY29 to the Market for Sale by Private Treaty.

Located in the ever popular development of Carleton Village – which offers a mix of houses and apartments within a managed gated complex, with secure parking, landscaped communal areas, a Tennis Court and children’s play area. This pretty development has vehicular access from Golf Links Road and pedestrian access onto the Light House Hill (just behind the Walter Raleigh Hotel).

Apartment 65 is ideally situated in the last block of apartments on the western side of the complex and as such is just a short walk to the Walter Raleigh Hotel, Green Park and Promenade, Beach, Primary Schools, and Bus Stops. The historic town centre is within a 15 minute walk or a short drive. 

Apartment 65 presents to market as a Ground Floor 2 Bedroom Apartment in turnkey condition - with a very bright and airy atmosphere and stylish interior design. 

Number 65 has been very carefully maintained and benefits from a host of upgrades including a fully fitted high end Kitchen, new on trend Shower Room, new super convenient Utility Room, Electric heating upgrade – and achieves a cosy B3 Building Energy Rating. 

A key feature of this fabulous apartment is undoubtable the panoramic views over South Abbey and West Waterford headland and out over the Blackwater River to the Atlantic Ocean beyond - which is enjoyed from both the Open Plan Living Area and the Principle Bedroom.

As this is a ground floor apartment – a wonderful benefit of this property is the owners ability to open the Doors in the Lounge and step out onto a patio and lawn – a lovely place to unwind and enjoy the fresh air and magnificent views.

Apartment 65 is a gem and will appeal to a range of buyers – from those searching for a stylish turnkey home or those looking for a move in coastal getaway.

Viewing will not fail to impress

Annual Service Charge Applies
By Prior Appointment with Agent only
